reason: An orchestration plugin that automatically routes text and image-enabled requests across configured models using difficulty classification, vision processing, and fallback tiers.

summaries.zh: 根据任务难度和图像输入，在用户已配置的多个模型之间自动分流请求，并提供视觉处理与回退机制。
summaries.en: Automatically routes text and image-enabled requests among user-configured models by task difficulty, with vision processing and fallback tiers.

capabilities: Routes requests among configured language models based on task difficulty
Processes image inputs through a configured or default vision model
Makes model API calls using configured providers and models
Caches visual evidence and classifier results for configured periods
